title: GEOS-FP Near-Surface Temperature
credit: NASA’s Global Modeling and Assimilation Office; visualizer Joseph V. Ardizzone (NASA/GSFC)

legend.meaning: Ordered -40 to +40 degrees Celsius source colorbar, sampled row 90 columns 74–461. Report normalized visual position only; terrain shading prevents exact temperature recovery.

sourceProjection: Empirically aligned full-world equirectangular; no embedded CRS. Extent [-180,-90,180,90]. Recognizable Greenland, South America, Africa, Madagascar and Australia align with the existing geographic mask; exact coastlines remain approximate.
representedInterval: Timestamp transcribed from frame: 29 Oct 2026 05:00 EDT = 09:00 UTC. Averaging interval unknown. This is a frozen downloaded frame, not live weather.
limitations: Page describes sampling at both 2 m and 3 m; height unresolved. Source palette is non-monotonic in hue; match literal RGB, never generic blue-to-red hue ordering. Terrain shading and repeated colors introduce ambiguity. Logos and date overlay are excluded from sampling; gray pixels are not automatically missing, as the palette contains gray endpoints. Image estimates only, no measured Celsius values.
missingBehavior: Masked annotation pixels or RGB distance >120 yield no interpretable visual sample. Real zero normalized palette position remains valid.
sequenceVerification: Three fixed-camera 2048x1024 frames, shared source palette and annotation masks; normalization fixed. Ocean times from NASA date table; temperature times transcribed from image labels. Scientific averaging intervals unverified.
